summary_zh: 祖母把香蕉藏在神奇的大篮子里，我忍不住偷偷拿来吃，直到集市那天秘密终于藏不住了。

sentences.text: Grandma’s garden was wonderful, full of sorghum, millet, and cassava.
sentences.translation_zh: 祖母的菜园非常美妙，长满了高粱、小米和木薯。

sentences.text: But best of all were the bananas.
sentences.translation_zh: 但所有作物中最棒的还是香蕉。

sentences.text: Although Grandma had many grandchildren, I secretly knew that I was her favourite.
sentences.translation_zh: 虽然祖母有很多孙辈，但我私下里清楚自己是她最疼爱的一个。

sentences.text: She invited me often to her house.
sentences.translation_zh: 她常常邀请我去她家做客。

sentences.text: She also told me little secrets.
sentences.translation_zh: 她还会跟我说些小秘密。

sentences.text: But there was one secret she did not share with me: where she ripened bananas.
sentences.translation_zh: 但有一个秘密她没有跟我分享：那就是她在哪里催熟香蕉。

sentences.text: One day I saw a big straw basket placed in the sun outside Grandma’s house.
sentences.translation_zh: 一天，我看到祖母家门外的阳光下放着一个大草编篮子。

tokens.gloss_zh: 放置；摆放（过去分词作宾补）

sentences.text: When I asked what it was for, the only answer I got was, “It’s my magic basket.”
sentences.translation_zh: 当我问那是用来做什么的时候，得到的唯一回答却是：“这是我的魔法篮子。”

sentences.text: Next to the basket, there were several banana leaves that Grandma turned from time to time.
sentences.translation_zh: 篮子旁边放着几片香蕉叶，祖母时不时会把它们翻个面。

tokens.gloss_zh: 引出定语从句（指代香蕉叶）

sentences.text: I was curious.
sentences.translation_zh: 我感到好奇。

sentences.text: “What are the leaves for, Grandma?”
sentences.translation_zh: “这些叶子是做什么用的，祖母？”

sentences.text: I asked.
sentences.translation_zh: 我问道。

sentences.text: The only answer I got was, “They are my magic leaves.”
sentences.translation_zh: 得到的唯一回答却是：“它们是我的魔法树叶。”

sentences.text: After Grandma sent me to my mother on an errand and I came back, Grandma was sitting outside but with neither the basket nor the bananas.
sentences.translation_zh: 祖母打发我去母亲那里跑了一趟腿，等我回来时，祖母正坐在门外，但身边既没有篮子也没有香蕉。

tokens.gloss_zh: 与现在分词构成过去进行时

sentences.text: “Grandma, where is the basket, where are all the bananas, and where…” But the only answer I got was, “They are in my magic place.”
sentences.translation_zh: “祖母，篮子去哪儿了？所有香蕉都去哪儿了？还有……”但得到的唯一回答却是：“它们都在我的魔法地方呢。”

sentences.text: It was so disappointing!
sentences.translation_zh: 这真是太让人扫兴了！

tokens.gloss_zh: 令人失望的；令人扫兴的

sentences.text: Two days later, Grandma sent me to fetch her walking stick from her bedroom.
sentences.translation_zh: 两天后，祖母打发我去她卧室把拐杖拿过来。

sentences.text: As soon as I opened the door, I was welcomed by the strong smell of ripening bananas.
sentences.translation_zh: 我一打开房门，一股香蕉成熟的浓烈香味便迎面扑来。

tokens.gloss_zh: （与as soon连用引出时间从句）……就……
与过去分词构成被动语态
正在成熟的（现在分词作定语）

sentences.text: In the inner room was grandma’s big magic straw basket.
sentences.translation_zh: 里屋放着祖母那个神奇的大草编篮子。

sentences.text: It was well hidden by an old blanket.
sentences.translation_zh: 它被一条旧毯子遮盖得严严实实。

sentences.text: I lifted it and sniffed that glorious smell.
sentences.translation_zh: 我掀开毯子，闻着那美妙的香气。

sentences.text: Grandma’s voice startled me when she called, “What are you doing?
sentences.translation_zh: 祖母喊了一声，声音吓了我一跳：“你在干什么？

sentences.text: Hurry up and bring me the stick.”
sentences.translation_zh: 赶快把拐杖给我拿来。”

sentences.text: I hurried out with her walking stick.
sentences.translation_zh: 我赶紧拿着她的拐杖快步走了出来。

sentences.text: “What are you smiling about?”
sentences.translation_zh: “你在笑什么呢？”

sentences.text: Grandma asked.
sentences.translation_zh: 祖母问道。

sentences.text: Her question made me realise that I was still smiling at the discovery of her magic place.
sentences.translation_zh: 她的这一问让我意识到，自己脸上竟然还挂着发现了她“魔法之地”后的笑容。

sentences.text: The following day when grandma came to visit my mother, I rushed to her house to check the bananas once more.
sentences.translation_zh: 第二天，祖母来探望我母亲，我急忙赶到她家，想再去看看那些香蕉。

sentences.text: There was a bunch of very ripe ones.
sentences.translation_zh: 篮子里有一串熟透了的香蕉。

sentences.text: I picked one and hid it in my dress.
sentences.translation_zh: 我摘下一根，藏在裙子底下。

sentences.text: After covering the basket again, I went behind the house and quickly ate it.
sentences.translation_zh: 把篮子重新盖好后，我走到房子后面，很快就把它吃掉了。

sentences.text: It was the sweetest banana I had ever tasted.
sentences.translation_zh: 那真是我尝过的最甜的香蕉了。

tokens.gloss_zh: 与过去分词构成过去完成时

sentences.text: The following day, when grandma was in the garden picking vegetables, I sneaked in and peered at the bananas.
sentences.translation_zh: 又过了一天，祖母在菜园里摘菜，我悄悄溜了进去，仔细端详着那些香蕉。

sentences.text: Nearly all were ripe.
sentences.translation_zh: 几乎所有的香蕉都熟了。

sentences.text: I couldn’t help taking a bunch of four.
sentences.translation_zh: 我忍不住拿了一串，共有四根。

sentences.text: As I tiptoed towards the door, I heard grandma coughing outside.
sentences.translation_zh: 当我踮着脚尖朝门口走去时，听见祖母在门外咳嗽。

sentences.text: I just managed to hide the bananas under my dress and walked past her.
sentences.translation_zh: 我好不容易才把香蕉藏到裙子底下，然后从她身边走了过去。

tokens.gloss_zh: 设法做到；好不容易做到

sentences.text: The following day was market day.
sentences.translation_zh: 随后的那一天正是集市日。

sentences.text: Grandma woke up early.
sentences.translation_zh: 祖母一大早就醒了。

sentences.text: She always took ripe bananas and cassava to sell at the market.
sentences.translation_zh: 她总是会带上熟香蕉和木薯去集市上卖。

sentences.text: I did not hurry to visit her that day.
sentences.translation_zh: 那天我没有急着去看望她。

sentences.text: But I could not avoid her for long.
sentences.translation_zh: 但我不可能躲得了太久。

sentences.text: Later that evening I was called by my mother and father, and Grandma.
sentences.translation_zh: 那天傍晚，母亲、父亲还有祖母一起把我叫了过去。

sentences.text: I knew why.
sentences.translation_zh: 我心里很清楚这是为什么。

sentences.text: That night as I lay down to sleep, I knew I could never steal again, not from grandma, not from my parents, and certainly not from anyone else.
sentences.translation_zh: 那天夜里躺下睡觉时，我深知自己再也不会偷东西了——不偷祖母的，不偷父母的，当然也绝不再偷任何人的了。

rights.author: Ursula Nafula
rights.modifications: 压缩一次跑腿和回家后的重复追问，保留发现、偷拿和后果。 中文翻译及语境词注。
